Markets.title: Big Bull's magic: How Rakesh Jhunjhunwala turned Rs 1 crore into Rs 20 crore overnight after the 1989 budget
Markets.summary: Following the 1989 Union Budget, 29-year-old Rakesh Jhunjhunwala went against prevailing market panic by betting that the government would pursue growth-oriented policies. This contrarian bet allowed him to turn Rs 1 crore into Rs 20 crore overnight.

Markets.summary: Last week, five of India's ten most valuable firms lost a combined Rs 1 lakh crore in market capitalization, with Tata Consultancy Services taking the biggest hit. Despite this market volatility, Reliance Industries remained the country's most valuable domestic entity.

Markets.summary: Nearly 100 companies, including Bandhan Bank and LIC Housing Finance, have set record dates this week for corporate actions like dividends, bonus issues, and stock splits. Investors must hold these shares before the ex-record dates to be eligible for the payouts.

Geo-Political.title: Five killed as Russia launches fresh aerial attacks across Ukraine
Geo-Political.summary: Russian aerial attacks across Ukraine killed five people and targeted civilian infrastructure, according to Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky. Meanwhile, Moscow reported that a warehouse was struck during the operations.

Geo-Political.summary: At least 51 people have been killed and thousands displaced following a deadly earthquake in Indonesia. Hundreds of homes and public buildings suffered severe damage as rescue operations continue.

Geo-Political.summary: Hurricane Lala is bringing strong winds and torrential rain to Hawaii. A direct landfall would make this Hawaii's first hurricane hit in 34 years.

Geo-Political.summary: Twelve people were killed and dozens of others seriously injured when a Polish tourist bus veered off a Hungarian motorway. The accident occurred when the vehicle overturned in the early hours of Sunday morning.

Geo-Political.title: Morocco detains dozens of migrants trying to cross into Ceuta, reports say
Geo-Political.summary: Moroccan security forces detained dozens of migrants attempting to cross the border into the Spanish enclave of Ceuta. The detentions occurred after social media posts suggested a second mass crossing would take place on Saturday.

Geo-Political.summary: Liechtenstein has changed its succession rules to permit women to ascend the throne. This announcement was made during the national day of the small central European nation.

Data & Insights.title: India's WPI inflation cools marginally to 9.78% in July as fuel prices ease
Data & Insights.summary: India's Wholesale Price Index (WPI) inflation dipped slightly to 9.78% in July due to a slowdown in fuel and power price increases to 20.05%. However, inflation accelerated for both primary articles, rising to 8.52%, and manufactured products, increasing to 8.29%.

Data & Insights.title: India’s merchandise trade gap widens to a six-month high of $31.98 bn in July
Data & Insights.summary: India's merchandise trade gap widened to a six-month high of $31.98 billion in July. However, merchandise exports for the April-July period rose 17% to $173.78 billion compared to the previous year.

Data & Insights.title: US consumer inflation falls to 3.4% year-on-year in July: Govt
Data & Insights.summary: US consumer inflation slowed to 3.4% year-on-year in July amid fluctuating oil prices. This decrease matches analyst expectations and may give the Federal Reserve more flexibility regarding interest rates.

Data & Insights.title: India's retail inflation breaches RBI's midpoint target for second successive month, rises to 4.45% in July
Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation rose to 4.45% in July, staying above the Reserve Bank of India's 4% midpoint target for the second consecutive month. This increase was driven by rising food and fuel prices, while elevated oil prices continue to pose risks.

Data & Insights.title: Fitch retains India's BBB- sovereign credit rating for 20th year, forecasts GDP growth at 6.4% — Here's what it means
Data & Insights.summary: Fitch Ratings has maintained India's BBB- sovereign credit rating for the 20th consecutive year, supported by a strong economic growth outlook of 6.4%. However, the agency also highlighted potential fiscal risks arising from youth protests over employment issues.

India.title: Air India Express Flyer's Gun Goes Off At Varanasi Airport, 2 Security Staffers Injured
India.summary: A passenger's gun accidentally discharged at the Varanasi airport, injuring two security staffers. The incident occurred while the traveler and his wife were preparing to board an Air India Express flight to Mumbai.

India.title: "Pursue Continuous Learning, Remain Curious": Vice President Interacts With School Students
India.summary: India's Vice President interacted with school students and encouraged them to interact with the world around them. He advised the children to pursue continuous learning, stay curious, and embrace new opportunities.

India.title: After Ambala And Hansi, Haryana Police Braces For Protests In Khanauri
India.summary: Farmers from Haryana and Punjab are preparing to march toward Delhi to protest the proposed India-US trade deal. In anticipation, Haryana Police are bracing for demonstrations in Khanauri following similar protests in Ambala and Hansi.

India.summary: The Income Tax Appellate Tribunal is hiring for 42 Senior and Private Secretary positions across its national benches. Applications for these vacancies must be submitted by August 16, 2026.

India.summary: Registration for Karnataka PG Dental Admissions 2026 opened through the KEA on August 14, 2026. Eligible candidates can now apply by completing the registration process.
